A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the great genomic diversity of the emerging DS-1 like G1P[6] strains was generated through the intergenogroup and inter-species reassortment.
the great genomic diversity observed among DS-1-like strains was generated through reassortments involving human and/or animal rotavirus strains.
the great genomic diversity of DS-1-lineage strains was generated through reassortments involving human and animal rotavirus strains.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the DS-1 like G1P[ 8] strains are not a monophyletic group and have emerged as a result of reassortment of human and animal rotaviruses, and that the reassortants can be more diverse than previously anticipated.
the emergence and rapid spread in Asia of unusual rotavirus genotypes and strains having DS-1-like genotypes and/or genotype constellations are ongoing.
